summary_en: GREE Holdings raised its dividend policy target from DOE 4% to DOE 5%, with full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending June 2027 increased from 22 yen to 27.5 yen per share, maintaining minimum payout ratio of 30%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Dividend Policy and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On November 11, 2026, GREE Holdings announced a change to its dividend policy and a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027. The company raised its dividend policy target from DOE (Dividend on Equity) of approximately 4% to approximately 5%, while maintaining a minimum consolidated payout ratio of approximately 30%. Under the revised forecast, the full-year dividend per share for fiscal 2027 will be 27.5 yen, consisting of 13.75 yen for the first half and 13.75 yen for the second half, compared to the previous forecast of 22 yen (11 yen each). This revision represents a 25% increase from the previously announced guidance. The change was made as part of the company's newly established capital allocation policy designed to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns. The Board of Directors intends to formally determine the interim dividend in February 2027.
